# lamost testdata

low-*.xml and medium-*.xml are the answers of LAMOST DR10 v2.0's TAP
service, recorded on 2026-11-06, to the queries lamost.Find makes: for
the replay circle round Sgr A*, south of LAMOST's sky and so empty, and
for half a degree round RA 180, Dec +30, at most 3 of each resolution.
asked-sgra.txt and asked-three.txt are the addresses asked, low first.

The crafted-*.xml files are the recorded answers edited by hand, each
one way: a column renamed (obsid, class, subclass, snrr, file, snr) or
a spectrum's file left empty, low or medium.
